mapper.select:
SELECT FEED_ID, TEAM_ID, USER_ID, FEED_TITLE, FEED_CONTENT, FEED_CATEGORY, FEED_VIEWS, FEED_LIKES, FEED_COMMENT_COUNT, FEED_IMAGE_PATH, FEED_IMAGE_NAME, FEED_DELETED_FLAG, CREATED_DATE, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_DATE, UPDATED_BY, DELETED_DATE, DELETED_BY FROM TB_FEED WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId} AND FEED_CATEGORY = #{category} AND FEED_DELETED_FLAG = 0
ORDER BY FEED_LIKES DESC
ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FEED ( FEED_ID, TEAM_ID, USER_ID, FEED_TITLE, FEED_CONTENT, FEED_CATEGORY, FEED_IMAGE_PATH, FEED_IMAGE_NAME, CREATED_DATE, CREATED_BY, FEED_VIEWS, FEED_LIKES, FEED_COMMENT_COUNT, FEED_DELETED_FLAG ) VALUES ( SEQ_FEED_ID.NEXTVAL, #{teamId}, #{userId}, #{feedTitle}, #{feedContent}, #{feedCategory}, #{feedImagePath}, #{feedImageName}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0 )
